current_finding: The near-extremal candidate is REFUTED as an EP. Three independent tests: Solver C shows no spectral dip there (contrast 0.13 vs ~1e11 at a genuine QNM); Solver A does not converge at those parameters (drifts 2-6e-4 per depth doubling with residual stuck at 1e-13); and the three solvers agree only to 3.5e-3, three orders above the claimed |dF/domega|=4.3e-6. The small derivative was Solver A's non-convergent drift. Mechanism: near extremality the spurious singularity x(-r_+) crowds the unit circle and the Frobenius radius degenerates.
